title: The calibrated block holds through 30 degrees and first slides at 32 degrees on the authored friction pair
claim: For the exact L1.2 free block on seven independent real-Jolt slopes with the authored friction 0.6 material pair at 60 Hz, post-step hold-versus-slide classification brackets the static threshold between the 30 degree and 32 degree slopes. This is consistent with tan(30 deg) = 0.577 below and tan(32 deg) = 0.625 above the authored coefficient, and gravity normal/tangent decomposition balanced on every measured slope.
scope: One unjointed rigid block on inclined static floors at seven preregistered angles, equal authored friction 0.6, rough=false, bounce 0, no damping or hidden constraints, fresh world per slope, 60 Hz Jolt physics, Godot 4.7, full_contacts_v2 observer; rotated-normal, cross-slope, and tipping contamination gates enforced.
mechanism: On a slope of angle theta a static body's required friction ratio is tan(theta). The measured hold at 30 degrees and slide at 32 degrees brackets the effective static coefficient for this material pair inside 0.577-0.625, which contains the authored 0.6. Classification uses post-step motion, not the pre-constraint callback candidate documented by L1.1.
applicability: Predicting whether the canonical material pair can statically hold a support on a measured slope
Cross-checking the L1.1 flat-floor breakaway bracket by an independent geometry
failure_boundaries: Does not cover other friction values, materials, curvature, or surface roughness
Does not cover intermediate unmeasured angles inside 30-32 degrees beyond the bracket itself
Does not cover articulated bodies or actuated limbs on slopes
Does not establish standing, bracing, fall arrest, getting up, or walking

parameter_effects.change: increase across the seven preregistered angles
parameter_effects.mechanism: Required tangential support tan(theta) crosses the effective static friction coefficient between 30 and 32 degrees
hinges_on: Equal authored friction 0.6 with rough=false on both surfaces
No tipping or cross-slope contamination in the measured window

minimal_repair_rules.symptom: A static support placement on a slope steeper than the measured hold bracket keeps sliding
minimal_repair_rules.diagnosis: Required tangential ratio tan(theta) exceeds the measured effective static friction for this material pair
minimal_repair_rules.smallest_change: Reduce the support slope below the measured 30 degree hold angle or re-measure with the actual material pair
minimal_repair_rules.expected_effect: Post-step slide classification returns to hold on the measured pair
do_not_apply_when: The material pair, normal load regime, or backend differs from the measured fixture

unknowns: Where the exact threshold sits inside the unmeasured 30-32 degree interval
Whether the bracket shifts with normal load, contact area, or solver configuration
How compliant or articulated feet change effective slope holding
